answer_1.quote: Neural Machine Translation (NMT) has become the dominant methodology for real-world machine translation applications and production systems.

answer_2.quote: Following Guerreiro et al. (2022a), we report Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve (AUROC) as our primary metric, and False Positive Rate at 90% True Positive Rate (FPR@90TPR) as a secondary metric.
